database.description: A database selected for this connection. Required when the connection has more than one selected database.

sql.description: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE or DDL. PostgreSQL: up to 20 statements, run in one transaction. MySQL, Oracle and SQL Server: one statement. Oracle DDL commits implicitly. A person approves the exact text.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
